SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:

 *189. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:

pleased to state:

the details of proposed power exchange in
the country;
(b)  if so, the details of the functioning

transmission network to facilitate transfer
of power;

up the regulatory mechanism to ascertain
the selection of promoters of power
exchanges; and
(g) whether State distribution agencies
will also be required to purchase power
from these exchanges?
